mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuthRequiredEverywhere allows Alloy to construct an EditOperation, DeleteOperation, or CreateOperation with no caller (unauthenticated). The injected violation forces such a callerless DeleteOperation to exist, which the AuthRequiredEverywhere and FR_001_AuthRequired assertions should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthViolation { some op : DeleteOperation | no op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyDeletionLog allows two distinct DeleteOperations to share the same TaskDeletion log entry, violating the one-entry-per-deletion invariant. The injected violation forces two DeleteOperations to share a log entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2 : DeleteOperation | op1.logEntry = op2.logEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AttributionCorrectness lets a CreateOperation produce a Task whose creator is a different Member than the operation's authenticated caller. The injection forces this mismatch, directly violating FR-002 and FR-009.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some op : CreateOperation | some m : Member | m != op.caller and op.produced.creator = m }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_ClosedTaskEditRule allows an EditOperation targeting a Done task to carry no newStatus (or to set newStatus = Done), representing an illegal in-place edit of a closed task. The injection forces such an operation to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskViolation { some op : EditOperation | op.target.status = Done and no op.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_DeletionLogged allows a DeleteOperation whose logEntry.deletedBy differs from its caller, breaking the attribution invariant in the deletion audit trail. The injection forces this misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DeletionLogViolation { some op : DeleteOperation | some m : Member | m != op.caller and op.logEntry.deletedBy = m }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_InitialStatusTodo allows a CreateOperation to produce a Task whose initial status is InProgress or Done rather than Todo. The injection forces a newly produced Task to have status Done.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InitialStatusViolation { some op : CreateOperation | op.produced.status = Done }
